content.value_statement: Multi-site UniFi environments are hard to review when site data is scattered. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code summarize sites, details, and site-level structure.
actual_capabilities: Lists UniFi sites available in the connected account.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific UniFi site.
Gets overview statistics for selected sites.
Supports multi-site inventory and organization summaries.
Helps compare site details for planning and standardization.
limitations: Requires configured UniFi access through the surrounding tool environment.
Does not create, modify, or delete UniFi sites.
Cannot verify physical site conditions without external data.
Report accuracy depends on current UniFi account permissions and data.

use_cases.title: Create a Site Inventory
use_cases.description: List all managed UniFi sites and prepare a clear inventory for reporting.

use_cases.title: Review Site Configuration
use_cases.description: Inspect details for a selected site and compare settings against expected standards.

use_cases.title: Plan Multi-Site Growth
use_cases.description: Use site details and overview data to identify expansion needs across locations.

prompt_templates.title: List My Sites
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a basic account overview.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me all UniFi sites in my account with their names and basic identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Site
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of one known location.
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the details for the headquarters UniFi site and summarize its key configuration information.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Inventory Report
prompt_templates.prompt: List all UniFi sites, gather details for each site, and create a concise inventory report grouped by location or organization.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Site Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for standardization or expansion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare all UniFi sites for missing details, inconsistent naming, and expansion planning risks. Recommend the next review actions.

output_examples.input: Show me all UniFi sites in my account.
output_examples.output: A site list with each site name, identifier, organization context, and a short summary of available information.

output_examples.input: Compare site details across all locations.
output: A grouped comparison of site settings and overview data.
Notes about missing or inconsistent information.

output_examples.input: Get a complete site inventory for reporting.
output_examples.output: A structured inventory summary that includes site counts, site names, notable details, and reporting-ready observations.

best_practices: Use consistent site names before comparing locations.
Review site details regularly to keep inventories current.
Confirm account permissions before relying on incomplete site data.
anti_patterns: Do not assume missing sites are offline without checking account access.
Do not use outdated inventory exports as the source of truth.
Do not compare sites without noting gaps in available details.

faq.question: Can this skill modify UniFi sites?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflows focus on listing, reviewing, comparing, and reporting site information.

faq.question: Which tools does the skill reference?
faq.answer: It references list_sites, get_site_details, and get_site_overview as UniFi site management tools.

faq.question: Does it support multi-site reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to gather site information and produce multi-site inventory summaries.

faq.question: Does it need UniFi account access?
faq.answer: Yes. Results depend on the connected UniFi account and the permissions available to the tool environment.

faq.question: Can it help with expansion planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize current site structure and help identify planning gaps across locations.

faq.question: Is this skill specific to one AI tool?
faq.answer: No. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
